App.Subtitle: Local AI workshop for Windows
SessionTree.Title: Session tree
SessionTree.Hint: Decisions, knowledge, and working result of the current session. Double-click a node to collapse its branch.
SessionTree.SelectNode: Select a tree node to view its full content.
Home.Headline: Prepare space for local AI
Home.Description: AI_HUB will store models, results, and service files on the drives you choose. Nothing is downloaded or changed without your confirmation.
Home.ModelsStorageEmpty: Choose a drive and limit for future downloads.
Home.ResultsStorageEmpty: Keep generated files separate from models and cache.
Home.ComputerPassportEmpty: Check RAM, GPU, VRAM, and free space.
Setup.Title: AI HUB setup
Setup.Description: This is a preparation page for the future setup wizard. For now, the program only creates the computer passport and does not change system settings.
Setup.PriorityHint: The first address is used by default. Other addresses can be selected manually later where needed.
Setup.StorageHelp: Add a path manually or choose a Windows folder. The nearby field is this address limit in GB.
Setup.AddressTooltip: You can paste or type the path manually
Setup.LocationLimitTooltip: Limit for this address in GB
Settings.Title: Settings
Settings.Description: General interface and local core voice settings for AI HUB.
Settings.LanguageHelp: You can choose a built-in language or add your own translation JSON file to the user localization folder.
Settings.CoreVoiceHelp: A local synthetic voice speaks the core's short thoughts and questions. Future tool-model voices are configured separately.
Settings.CoreVoiceRhVoiceUnavailable: RHVoice is not installed; prepare the official local voice
Settings.CoreVoiceTestPhrase: Test complete. The local core voice is ready.
Settings.CoreVoiceUnavailable: The local voice is currently unavailable; text modes will continue to work
Profile.Title: User profile
Profile.Description: The profile is stored locally and helps AI HUB address you correctly, consider your location, and choose a work style.
Profile.IdentityHelp: Used so the model can address the user and later fill the author field in documents.
Profile.LocationHelp: Used for answers where country, city, region, time zone, or local context matters.
Profile.AnswerPreferencesHelp: Choose how AI HUB should usually shape answers. You can select multiple options.
Profile.WorkloadHelp: This does not forbid other options, but it affects how future tool recommendations are ordered.
Profile.WorkloadLightDescription: Try to keep PC load below 80%, prefer lighter models and simpler tools.
Profile.WorkloadBalancedDescription: Default mode: choose load based on the computer passport.
Profile.WorkloadExtremeDescription: Allow heavy options up to about 150% of comfortable load. May be slower and more demanding on RAM/VRAM/CPU/GPU.
Profile.ReminderDescription: The profile helps AI HUB address you correctly, consider location, and choose answer style and tools. You can fill it now or continue without a profile.
WorkStart.Title: Start work
WorkStart.ReasoningDescription: Follow short choice steps, build a task card, and identify the model or tool needed next.
WorkStart.PreviousExampleName: Study: "How to choose a local AI model"
WorkStart.ContinueTooltip: Continuing previous projects will be added later
WorkStart.Empty: There are no saved sessions yet.
WorkStart.DeleteConfirmation: Delete the selected sessions: {0}? This cannot be undone. Exported documents will remain in place.
ChoiceScenario.Title: Uncertainty mode
ChoiceScenario.Description: AI HUB will identify the required capabilities, tools, and a suitable executor model.
ChoiceScenario.CoreVoiceDisable: Mute the core voice and show the full message
ChoiceScenario.CustomInputHelp: Keep it short, 1-3 words. Example: Career change.
ChoiceScenario.StepStatus: Choose one option. If none fits, use a short custom option.
ChoiceScenario.FinalStatus: This is not the final answer. It is a prepared card for a future executor model.
ChoiceScenario.CoreWorking: The core is preparing the next scenario step.
ChoiceScenario.StructureError: The core's next response did not pass validation, so the previous step remains on screen. Try again or go to final.
ChoiceScenario.StartQuestion: What is the question closest to?
ChoiceScenario.StartThought: First identify the broad domain only when it may change executor specialization.
ChoiceScenario.Start.GoalsRecommendation: Fits when the uncertainty is still hard to place in a specific area.
ChoiceScenario.FallbackQuestion: What is most important to clarify?
ChoiceScenario.FallbackThought: The core is unavailable, so AI HUB is showing a safe fallback step.
ChoiceScenario.Fallback.Subject: What to choose
ChoiceScenario.Fallback.SubjectDescripti: Define the subject of the choice.
ChoiceScenario.Fallback.CriteriaDescript: What matters most in the choice.
ChoiceScenario.Fallback.FindDescription: Find and verify the required information.
ChoiceScenario.Fallback.ExplainDescripti: Clearly explain information that is already known.
ChoiceScenario.Fallback.CompareDescripti: Compare several approaches or possible decisions.
ChoiceScenario.Fallback.CreateDescriptio: Prepare text, code, an image, or another result.
ChoiceScenario.RepeatedStepError: The core repeated a completed step. Choose another path or move to the final card.
ChoiceScenario.CoreUnavailableStop: The core is unavailable, so narrowing cannot continue now. Go back or cancel the scenario.
ChoiceScenario.BudgetQuestion: How many steps should model selection take?
ChoiceScenario.BudgetThought: I will plan the clarifications around this budget and finish earlier when enough information is available.
ChoiceScenario.Budget.QuickDescription: Only the most important branches, followed by a quick result.
ChoiceScenario.Budget.NormalDescription: Balanced task clarification without unnecessary detail.
ChoiceScenario.Budget.DetailedDescriptio: Deeper clarification of criteria, constraints, and context.
ChoiceScenario.Budget.AutomaticDescripti: The core chooses the depth; the safety limit is 30 steps.
Executor.CorePreferred: The core considers this the preferred option
Executor.CustomInputHelp: Enter your answer or add details that the executor should consider.
Executor.StageReadyBody: Review the collected input. If it is correct, continue to practical result clarification.
Executor.ResultAvailableBody: The executor prepared a current version. Select “Show result” to open it as a separate document. The session will remain active.
Executor.ResultWindowHint: You can select and copy document text with Ctrl+C. Closing this window does not end the session.
Executor.StageRecommended: The technical brief is ready for confirmation.
Executor.LivePreviewHint: This is an interim summary. It updates after every clarification.
Executor.LivePreviewWaiting: The executor is preparing the first concise summary of the available result.
Executor.VoiceDisable: Mute the executor voice and show the full message
Executor.Starting: The executor is reading the background data and preparing its first question.
Executor.ReadyToFinishTitle: The executor considers the result ready
Executor.ReadyToFinishBody: You can finish the work or continue refining it. The decision remains yours.
Executor.FinishDialogDescription: You can close the work without a result or ask the executor to produce a final document.
Executor.OutputDialogHeading: How should the final result be delivered?
Executor.OutputDialogDescription: Direct output opens the document in AI HUB. Export saves the same document as a DOCX file.
Executor.FinalResultWindowHint: This is the final document from the completed session. You can select and copy its text with Ctrl+C.
